meta.title: Moodbow — A journal that learns your story

support.title: Support
support.description: Get help with Moodbow: email us with questions, problems or ideas.
support.body: Questions, problems or ideas? Email us and we'll get back to you.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your Moodbow account
accountDeletion.description: How to delete your Moodbow account and everything in it.
accountDeletion.intro: You can delete your account and everything in it at any time. Deleting is immediate and can't be undone.
accountDeletion.steps: In the app or on the web: open Me → Delete account, type DELETE, and confirm.
accountDeletion.what: We delete your entries, check-ins, AI reflections and reports, what Moodbow remembers, your settings and your login.
accountDeletion.backups: Copies in our encrypted backups are removed automatically within {days} days.
accountDeletion.noAccess: Can't sign in? Email <support>{email}</support> from the address you signed up with and we'll delete it for you.

onboarding.welcome1Title: A journal that learns your story
onboarding.welcome1Body: Log your mood, sleep and movement in seconds, and write about your day when you feel like it.
onboarding.welcome2Body: Your timeline and charts show what makes good days better, and what tends to come before hard ones.
onboarding.welcome3BodyNoAi: Only you can read your journal, and you can delete everything at any time.
onboarding.consentPrivacy: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy
onboarding.consentHealth: I agree that Moodbow stores and processes my journal, which can include information about my health and wellbeing, to provide the service.
onboarding.signupHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

ai.consentAiBody: To write reflections and reports, Moodbow sends your entries and logs to our AI provider, Anthropic (USA), only when needed. They aren't used to train AI models. You can turn this off any time in Me → AI.
ai.meAiOffHint: AI is off. Your journal works the same; you just won't get reflections or reports.
ai.creditsLiteNow: You're on Moodbow AI Lite: shorter, simpler answers, free every day.
ai.creditsOut: You've used your Moodbow AI credits. We'll keep going with Moodbow AI Lite, so answers will be shorter and simpler.
ai.reflectDeleteConfirmBody: Your entry stays. This can't be undone.
ai.reflectError: Moodbow couldn't reflect right now. Your entry is saved.
ai.dailyLimit: You've reached today's AI limit. It resets tomorrow. Your journal still works as usual.
ai.errOffline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
ai.errRateLimited: Please wait a minute and try again.
ai.reportNotEnough: Check in on at least 3 days this week to get a weekly report.
ai.reportError: Moodbow couldn't look back at your week right now. Try again in a moment.
ai.reportDeleteConfirmBody: You can get a new one for this week. This can't be undone.

safety.safetyTitle: You don't have to go through this alone
safety.safetyBody: It sounds like things are really hard right now. Talking to someone can help, today.
safety.safetyEmergency: If you're in danger right now, call your local emergency number.
safety.safetyFindHelpline: Find a helpline in your country
safety.safetyNotTherapy: Moodbow isn't a substitute for professional help.
